scope: Opt-in lazy isolated Engine runtime overlay for command previews. Default deep-clone behavior is unchanged; API flag wiring remains root-owned.

writeSurfaces: Map assignments/deletions stay in a clone-local overlay.
Audit history is an immutable borrowed sequence with clone-local append.
Escalation keys are copied; unknown runtime attributes are deep-copied as a safety fallback.
Static Engine contracts are shared as with the existing preview clone.
safety: Base dictionaries, lists, and tuple contents are exposed through recursive immutable borrowed views; nested mutation raises TypeError.
Engine.get still deep-copies records before command mutation; _save and related map updates write to local overlays.
Each preview receives a fresh overlay. The caller must keep it within the source read transaction.
The existing deep clone remains the default fallback.

evidenceBeforeOverlay.benchmark: 50k rows, 45k project rows, 3 live TCP rounds; project filtering and two non-overlapping page-1 rows passed.
evidenceBeforeOverlay.page100: HTTP request exceeded the fixture's 60-second timeout.
evidenceBeforeOverlay.meaning: Authorization input caching improved page 1, but page 100 remains a blocking performance limit.

pageSizeOne.checks: project total and two non-overlapping cursor pages passed

pageSize100.checks: project total and two non-overlapping 100-row cursor pages passed

limitations: Synthetic records, one API process, and development JSON snapshot persistence; not production or concurrent-client evidence.
Exact totals still scan project membership and remain linear in snapshot size.
No latency SLO was found; performance acceptance/M4 signoff is not claimed.
Page-size-100 p95 is the max of two samples, not a stable percentile estimate.
